notes: Every fourth case uses one of the game's coefficient tables (0x17e3cc, 0x17e4ec); the others build a random table with 2..5 entries per axis, ascending random axes and random values. Cells are random valid lower corners; points lie in or up to a quarter cell outside the cell, and in one case in ten exactly on its lower axis entry. The corner fetch 0x11ac3c runs as original code.
